# exact inputs
a, b = F(213, 100), F(116, 100)
c, k, h = F(16, 100), F(5, 2), 1

def gam(t):
    return (t, -c * (t + k) ** 2 + h)

p = gam(F(0))

# derivative of the curve at t=0 (exact)
